comparison.objective: Hold an acrylic sheet down, peel its protective film, and discard the film; candidate commissions a rigid damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization with pinch-peel deformable manipulation versus counterholding with rigid tool insertion, fine rotation, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Film fully removed without tab tear or sheet lift and deposited in basket versus two repeatable carriage stops with no hard-stop impact or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is generic; deformable peeling and rigid mechanical commissioning are meaningfully different tested abilities.
